change_requests.source: User instruction: Products becomes the user-facing ERP module and direct product/service list entry point; preserve catalog-named contracts, data, permissions and route as compatibility.

User confirmed the conceptual Products item model: finished products, raw materials/components and services; independent purchasing/selling/inventory uses; one primary hierarchical category; finished products allow buy/make/both sourcing, raw materials/components are buy-only for now, services have no sourcing, and variants inherit product sourcing; separately managed/sold variants have their own SKU; product, variant and category keys are LoopDev-generated, immutable, distinct from SKU/name and unique within the organization; semimanufactured items deferred until Manufacturing discovery.

Product Owner approved organization-scoped reusable product/variant media with metadata and alt text; automatic publication is excluded. Visual composition approval was separately recorded on 2026-10-25.
